weight_families.method: Vary one family mass p in [0,1]; divide 1-p among the other families in proportion to their scenario counts in the central design; divide each family mass equally among its members.
weight_families.uniform_reference: Equal weight per one of the 12 scenario rows; group masses therefore brief=5/12, moderate=3/12, prolonged=3/12, fast_recovery=1/12. This is a mathematical reference, not an operational probability.

bootstrap.resampling_unit: seed ID; all 12 scenarios and 3 policies for each sampled seed stay together
